references.context: Higher category theory: square of 1-morphisms equipped with specified invertible comparison 2-cell
Higher category theory: filler of a given 2-commutative square satisfying compatibility equations

references.disposition: Arrows in this filler category must commute with the specified 2-cell data, not arbitrary isomorphisms of its ambient objects.

review_rationale: Read the specified 2-commutative square, invertible 2-morphisms, diagonal fillers, and compatible modifications between fillers; retained the (2,1)-category setting rather than replacing it with ordinary commuting squares.
